text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. speaker: Doctor
text: I will examine your eyes for signs of vertical supranuclear gaze palsy and check for any other neurological deficits. Have you experienced any recent falls, difficulty walking, or changes in your balance?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inappropriate behavior. I also have Disinterest in family interactions, Craving for specific foods, Significant weight gain, Apathy, Blunted affect.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your symptoms of apathy, disinhibition, and dietary changes, I suspect frontal lobe involvement. I will order an MRI of the brain to check for frontal lobe atrophy. REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRI is normal, I need to rule out metabolic or systemic causes. Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels, skin texture, or tolerance to cold?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical history provided. Social history: No detailed social history provided; recent behavior includes attempting to initiate inappropriate physical contact with strangers.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prominent disinhibition and hyperorality with a normal structural MRI, I suspect Frontotemporal Dementia (behavioral variant). Let's rule out metabolic causes like thyroid dysfunction. REQUEST TEST: TSH

speaker: Doctor
text: With the MRI and TSH normal, I need to assess your cognitive profile further. Have you noticed any decline in your ability to plan, organize tasks, or solve problems, or have your family observed memory issues?

speaker: Patient
text: The patient avoids questions and instead comments on unrelated subjects. Shows apathy towards surroundings and interactions.

speaker: Doctor
text: Your avoidance of questions and profound apathy further support a diagnosis of behavioral variant Frontotemporal Dementia. To confirm this clinical suspicion, I will request specific medical images showing frontal and temporal lobe atrophy. REQUEST IMAGES
